bumped.rationale: Release-gate drain after v0.1.28 failed the freshness gate (run 36358282441). PowerShell tracks GitHub's Ubuntu 24.04 hosted-image manifest; actions/runner-images c9dd57c6b6333892b46abcc439ba0676fd03867a (2026-09-25, https://github.com/actions/runner-images/blob/c9dd57c6b6333892b46abcc439ba0676fd03867a/images/ubuntu/Ubuntu2404-Readme.md) lists PowerShell 7.6.6, and v7.6.6 (2026-09-08) passed the 14-day hard fail. The powershell-7.6.6-linux-x64.tar.gz checksum ddbc4a2d113bbd46d283cfedcbcd117a70caefd7673f41f2b4e0000badf103bc matches the GitHub release asset digest, the SHA256 list in the release notes, and an independent download hash. The v7.6.6 notes are a servicing patch (a Windows FileOnlyEntry crash fix, the WLDP EnableFileOnlyEntry setting, .NET SDK 10.0.401) with no security advisory or documented breaking change.
bumped.rolloutNote: PowerShell is baked into the worker image (Dockerfile POWERSHELL_VERSION / POWERSHELL_SHA256) and is a compatibility-pair input. Promotion requires a new reviewed compatibility pair and the provisioning rolling-upgrade runbook, not a merge alone.
